items.name: NZ South Island Championship 2022

venue.name: [Trafalgar Centre](http://www.nelson.govt.nz/recreation/venues-and-grounds/trafalgar-centre-2/)
venue.address: 7 Paru Paru Road, Nelson 7010, New Zealand

items.information: NZ South Island Championship 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, NZ South Island Championship 2022 is the first regional championship of 2022 in the lead up to Nationals later in 2022.

items.name: Oslo Open 2022
items.information: ## Informasjon Norsk: Velkommen til Oslo Open 2022! Dette er den første kube konkuransen i Oslo siden 2015! Vi gleder oss! Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). Påmeldingen åpner lørdag 28. mai kl 16:00 norsk tid. Det koster 150 NOK å delta. Prisen inkluderer et måltid med mat og drikke på lørdag. Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take away tilbud i nærområdet. Vi følger lokale koronarestriksjoner. Pr dd er det ingen særlige krav eller restriksjoner i Oslo. ## Information English: Welcome to Oslo Open 2022! This is the first cube competition in Oslo since 2015! You can register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). The registration opens Saturday 28 of May at 6:00 PM Norwegian time. We follow local Covid restrictions. As of today, there are no special requirements or restrictions in Oslo.
